old_caption: The video showcases a serene natural landscape featuring a majestic waterfall cascading down a rocky cliff into a vibrant blue pool below. The waterfall is multi-tiered, with water flowing over several levels before pooling at the base. The surrounding area is lush with greenery, including trees and shrubs that frame the scene. The rocks are rugged and textured, adding to the raw beauty of the environment. The water appears clear and crisp, reflecting the sky above. The overall atmosphere is tranquil and inviting, perfect for relaxation and meditation. There are no visible animals or human characters in the video, allowing the viewer to fully immerse themselves in the peaceful setting. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, capturing the continuous flow of the waterfall and the stillness of the surrounding nature.

caption: The video showcases a wide view of a mountain waterfall pouring over a horizontal rocky ledge into a turquoise plunge pool. Gray-brown cliffs covered with green moss, shrubs and conifers frame it along the top. The broad white cascade is already falling and keeps falling continuously. Its frothy sheet churns while the overall position and width stay constant. In the foreground a stream rushes over rounded brown and gray boulders, generating white rapids. The shape and brightness of these rapids swirl and shift. Subtle ripples move across the pool surface near the base of the falls. The underlying rocks, cliff walls, tree line and pool outline appear steady, while the moving water creates the visible change.

An internal editing cut is not evidence of physical motion connecting the views.

a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.

processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.
